G3dhpqopdT.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that connecting sample scoring to task similarity in continual learning is a clear, meaningful question with exact sign predictions matching simulations.
G3dhpqopdT.main_concern: Reviewers cite restrictive two-task linear assumptions, small theoretical and empirical effect sizes, limited novelty over prior task-similarity and gradient-projection work, and missing continual-learning selection baselines.

ejXw7lXyQ8.one_liner: Learns local manifold anchors on frozen closed-set features to initialize and update novel-class prototypes during online category discovery.
ejXw7lXyQ8.problem: On-the-Fly Category Discovery methods typically reshape closed-set backbones with specialized discovery objectives that entangle representation learning and streaming clustering.
ejXw7lXyQ8.method: SPARK freezes a closed-set classifier, learns non-redundant Local Manifold Anchors around each known class to approximate a shared superclass manifold, and analytically initializes and online-updates prototypes on this manifold when streaming samples are rejected as unknown.
ejXw7lXyQ8.key_idea: Approximate a shared superclass manifold using local anchors around frozen closed-set classes to analytically constrain online initialization of unknown-class prototypes.
ejXw7lXyQ8.evidence: Evaluated across seven public category-discovery benchmarks with ablations on stopping anchor gradients and streaming timing.
ejXw7lXyQ8.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers appreciate the simplicity of preserving frozen closed-set representations and using local manifold anchors for plug-and-play online prototype initialization.
ejXw7lXyQ8.main_concern: Reviewers note severe category over-fragmentation without known class counts (e.g., 4,709 vs. 683 on Herbarium19), missing recent 2026 baselines, and limited novelty over multi-prototype and subspace-projection methods.

WyVQRnb4dQ.one_liner: Benchmarks LLM agent shared-memory governance across utility, role-based access control, and active forgetting in multi-principal episodes.
WyVQRnb4dQ.problem: Existing LLM agent memory benchmarks assume single-user settings and neglect contextual authorization boundaries and explicit deletion in multi-principal environments.
WyVQRnb4dQ.method: GateMem provides 91 long-horizon multi-party episodes (~200 turns each) across medical, office, education, and household domains with incremental memory injection, hidden checkpoints, leak-target annotations, and structured judging of utility, access control, and active forgetting.
WyVQRnb4dQ.key_idea: Evaluate shared-memory agents jointly on long-horizon utility, contextual role-based access control, and post-deletion forgetting across multi-principal episodes.
WyVQRnb4dQ.evidence: Evaluated diverse long-context, RAG, and external-memory baselines across multiple LLM backbones with human validation of judge labels.
WyVQRnb4dQ.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that multi-principal shared-memory governance covering access control and deletion is an important, understudied deployment problem and that the four-domain dataset is useful.
WyVQRnb4dQ.main_concern: Reviewers question testing authorization enforcement inside the LLM rather than the application/retrieval layer, cite missing baseline implementation details hurting reproducibility, and note reliance on LLM-generated episodes.

DBRg2u6Tuk.one_liner: Jailbreaks open-weight LLMs by repeatedly sampling independent Gaussian noise added to prompt token embeddings.
DBRg2u6Tuk.problem: Existing jailbreak attacks on open-weight LLMs often require expensive gradient computation, per-prompt optimization, or permanent weight modifications.
DBRg2u6Tuk.method: Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV) adds independent Gaussian noise once to input prompt token embeddings and repeatedly resamples noise realizations until an unsafe response is produced.
DBRg2u6Tuk.key_idea: Repeatedly sample additive isotropic Gaussian perturbations on input token embeddings without gradient optimization or weight edits to bypass refusal.
DBRg2u6Tuk.evidence: Evaluated across six open-weight LLMs on JailbreakBench against I-GCG, Soft Prompt, Latent Fusion, RefusalCones, and NeuroStrike.
DBRg2u6Tuk.claimed_gains: Obtains the first successful jailbreak within one minute per model at up to an order of magnitude lower compute cost, jailbreaking 100% of JailbreakBench prompts within 20 runs on five of six models and 93% on the sixth.
DBRg2u6Tuk.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that the attack is clearly written, extremely simple to implement, and empirically effective at low compute cost on the tested models.
DBRg2u6Tuk.main_concern: Reviewers criticize missing Best-of-N sampling baselines, outdated/small target models, ambiguous batch timing accounting, and the claim of no optimization despite repeated resampling.

78y52HHy7d.one_liner: Fits transferable concept tokens directly inside frozen SAM-3's prompt space from a single image-mask pair for vocabulary-free segmentation.
78y52HHy7d.problem: Text prompts in SAM-3 fail on out-of-vocabulary concepts while geometric prompts must be supplied per query image, and existing few-shot segmentation methods struggle on fine-grained cross-domain targets.
78y52HHy7d.method: AwSAM freezes SAM-3 and optimizes transferable concept tokens directly in its shared prompt space from a single annotated support image-mask pair, optionally combined with a C-RADIOv4 linear localization branch that generates positive and negative query points.
78y52HHy7d.key_idea: Optimize a transferable concept token directly in frozen SAM-3's prompt space from one image-mask pair without class names or meta-learning.
78y52HHy7d.evidence: Evaluated across 12 diverse one-shot and five-shot segmentation benchmarks spanning natural objects, parts, medical, remote sensing, and defects.
78y52HHy7d.claimed_gains: Improves over the prior best method by 11.3 mIoU across diverse benchmarks (59.78 vs. 48.45 one-shot mIoU over INSID3, and 68.07 vs. 60.71 five-shot mIoU over M2C).
78y52HHy7d.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers praise the simplicity of optimizing tokens in SAM-3's prompt space and the large, broad empirical gains across 11 of 12 benchmarks.
78y52HHy7d.main_concern: Reviewers point out contradictory 'training-free' claims given ~5.5 s per-reference token fitting, unfair backbone comparisons (SAM-3 + C-RADIOv4 vs. older baselines), and a weak or unclear localization branch.
